_frozen: M7 CORRECTED FINAL CONFIGURATION. Two defects in the original M7 run are fixed here, both found by targeted review and both documented below. Every scientific threshold is unchanged from M1-M5; none was altered after seeing a result.
_why_resolution: 300 m analysis cells built by masking at native 30 m and averaging the valid pixels (aggregate_factor = 10). Full native 30 m analysis was benchmarked and rejected as impractical here, not assumed: the district holds 11,536,709 pixels at 30 m against 115,667 at 300 m, giving an estimated ~17 h of serial acquisition plus ~3.5 h of feature engineering. The corrected 300 m product costs ~57 min of acquisition. The cost of coarsening is quantified: nearest-sample and properly-aggregated NDVI differ by mean |delta| 0.065 over a test window, which is larger than the 0.05 NDVI disturbance threshold.
_why_rainfall: rainfall_accumulation = calendar_year rather than the configured hydrological_year default. CHIRPS monthly products are gzipped, which prevents windowed HTTP reads; only the annual products support them. The monsoon (Jun-Sep) still precedes the Oct-Dec NDVI composite, so the antecedent ordering RESTREND assumes is preserved, and no rain falling after the composite window enters the total.
_why_period: 1990-2024. Landsat Collection 2 covers the whole span with usable post-monsoon scenes in every year; CHIRPS annual currently ends at 2024.

reference.notes: EMPTY. No independent reference labels exist for this study area. Supervised experiments (Random Forest, CNN, ablation, spatial-CV metrics, discrimination) are therefore reported as BLOCKED BY DATA, not run. The analytical trajectory classes must NOT be substituted: they are computed from the same features a classifier would consume, so any accuracy against them measures self-consistency.

_acquisition.product: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Science Products
_acquisition.authentication: none; anonymous STAC search and anonymously-issued read tokens
_acquisition.scene_selection: least cloudy first, applied identically to every year
_acquisition.overview_policy: overviews used only to scout coverage, never for analysed values

_correction_1_boundary: The original run used a BOUNDING BOX (data/boundaries/karbi_anglong_bbox.geojson), which is not the district and includes substantial land outside it. This run uses the authoritative administrative polygon from geoBoundaries gbOpen India ADM2 (ODbL 1.0, 2021), merging Karbi Anglong East and West because the 2016 district split falls inside the 1990-2024 study period. Polygon area 10,410 km2 against a published ~10,434 km2 for the undivided district.
_correction_2_sampling: The original run read each scene at the 8x COG overview and sampled it onto the 300 m grid. Measurement (tools/benchmark_resolution.py) showed the archive 4x and 8x REFLECTANCE overviews are AVERAGES of the native pixels while the QA_PIXEL overviews are point samples - so reflectance was averaged across cloudy and clear pixels BEFORE masking, and was paired with a quality flag describing only one contributing pixel. This run reads every scene at NATIVE 30 m, applies the QA mask at 30 m, and averages only the surviving pixels into each 300 m cell, retaining the contributing-pixel count as a mixed-pixel diagnostic.
